_comment: Device profiler overhead CI golden (Wormhole, wh_n300_civ2). BRING-UP: real_time values are Blackhole-derived ESTIMATES (order-of-magnitude, from a local Blackhole capture) used as realistic placeholders until a real Wormhole run is captured; they are NOT gated yet. The runtime_perf_profiler_overhead CI job runs compare_profiler_overhead_ci.py with --ignore-times so only the benchmark set (names) is validated. Arm the gate by replacing these with a real profiler-enabled (ENABLE_TRACY=ON) benchmark_out JSON captured on wh_n300_civ2, then drop --ignore-times from the job. Metric = host-side real_time (ns) of the min aggregate: BM_profiler_read = ReadMeshDeviceProfilerResults writeout cost (dominant, multi-ms; largely fixed-cost), BM_profiled_dispatch = profiler-enabled EnqueueMeshWorkload+Finish (tens of us; shape-insensitive). Run WITHOUT TT_METAL_PROFILER_ACCUMULATE so each read performs the full L1->DRAM writeout.
